title: 第1章 乾劲！前进！第2章 学艺
content_zh:
第一章 乾劲！前进！
自从三天前从落日山脉回来之后，乾劲就一直把自己关在房间里，任凭室友怎么劝说也不肯出门见人。
“太丢人了……这实在是太丢人了！”
三天前，奥克兰学院为初级班新生安排了一次考试，地点就在落日山脉。
在参加考试的新生当中，乾劲绝对可以算得上是上等水准。
刚刚入学不到一年，就已经拥有了三级战士的水准，就连奥克兰学院战士系的教官，五级战士罗德里格斯都曾经说过——战士初级二班这批新生里，乾劲是比较有前途的，既有天赋又肯吃苦，说不定再过几年，这小子就能超过我这把老骨头了……
谁知道教官大人的话才刚说完，乾劲在落日山脉上就出事了。
战士初级二班这批新生中，很有前途的乾劲，还没来得及参加考试，就莫名其妙的被东西给砸晕了。
而砸晕他的，居然是一顶从天而降的帽子！
这件事被当成笑话传了回来，很快就在奥克兰学院传得沸沸扬扬。
如今几乎整个奥克兰学院都知道，初级班新生里有个长相犯罪的家伙，据说这家伙长相犯罪的程度，已经到了天怒人怨的地步，连参加一次考试，也能引得帽子从天而降，将他当场砸得晕了过去。
想到今后的数年时间里，自己会一直被人称为长相犯罪的家伙，乾劲真是连退学的心都有了。
“这日子真是没法过了……”
乾劲手上拿着的，正是那天将他砸晕的罪魁祸首。
这是一顶天蓝色的帽子，帽檐宽大，帽顶又高又尖，正是一顶标准的法师帽，在奥克兰学院，几乎每个魔法系的学生都会戴着一顶这样的帽子。
也正因为这样，乾劲才怎么也想不明白，这么一顶平凡的法师帽，怎么能把自己给砸得当场晕过去？
正百思不得其解时，房门又被人推开了。
进门来的是罗林，乾劲在奥克兰学院最好的朋友之一。
“哈哈哈！据说我们学院出了一位长相犯罪的人物……咦！乾劲，你脸色怎么这么难看？”
“靠！”

“乾劲你脸色这么难看，该不会是生病了吧？要不我帮你去罗斯教授那里拿点药剂？对了，我听说那天的考试，就是由罗斯教授带领的，也不知道他认不认识那家伙……”
“那家伙你也认识。”
“真的？”
“老子就是那个长相犯罪的家伙！”
“……”
赶走罗林，乾劲越想越是火大，干脆拿帽子把脸一盖，蒙头大睡起来。
…………
乾劲站在铁匠铺外，已经发了很长时间呆了。
“这究竟是什么鬼地方……”
这样一个问题，在过去的两个小时里，乾劲足足问了三十多次。
而那个自称系统精灵的声音，也不厌其烦的给他解释过三十多次。
“这里是无尽世界，一个采用第三代虚拟技术构筑的虚拟游戏空间。”
可乾劲还是不明白，什么叫第三代虚拟技术，什么叫虚拟游戏空间。
虚拟他倒是知道，幻术魔法中常用的一个词语。
游戏他也知道，就好象每年一届的奥克兰杯球赛一样。
可这两个词凑在一起，乾劲就有些莫名其妙了，象幻术魔法一样的球赛？靠！这都什么乱七八糟的……
于是系统精灵不得不继续解释，所谓的虚拟游戏，其实就是一个由数字构成的世界，这个世界看似无比真实，但实际上它只是一个由数字构成的空间，为了解释得更清楚一些，系统精灵还专门给出了一段数字，用以解释什么叫做数字空间。
职业：战士
等级：1
力量：18

敏捷：15
耐力：18
智力：15
精神：1
生命值：180/180
魔法值：110/110
精力值：180/180
乾劲知道这段数字是真的，自己在精神力上的先天残缺，只有自己最亲近的人才知道，如果不是这个原因，魔斗双修世家的自己，又怎么会跑到这个偏远的学校，选择战士作为自己的职业？
乾劲站在铁匠铺外，真是头都大了。
自从落日山脉考试之后，自己身上的怪事就一件接着一件。
先是被一顶从天而降的帽子打晕，考试泡汤不说，还落了个长相犯罪的名声，想躲在寝室里睡个觉，却一不小心睡到了另一个世界，而且还是一个由什么数字构成的虚拟世界，真是见他妈的鬼……
如果不是那个自称系统精灵的声音曾经说过，现实时间八小时后，玩家将会自动返回现实世界的话，乾劲真是连死的心都有了。
系统精灵说了这么多，大概也只有这句话，才能让乾劲稍稍安心一些。
反正只有八个小时，就当是做了一场梦好了……
抱着这样的想法，乾劲总算安心了一点。
乾劲一边在心里盘算着，该怎么打发这段时间，一边望着眼前的铁匠铺问道：“我们为什么要来这里？”
“因为在开始游戏之前，你还需要选择生活技能。”系统精灵的声音很好听，只是乾劲实在没有心情去欣赏这动听的声音。
“生活技能？”
“没错。”
还没等乾劲细想，系统精灵就为他传来了生活技能的资料。

看着这份资料，乾劲多多少少有些明白，所谓的数字世界是什么意思了。
从冶炼到锻造，从草药到药剂，林林总总数十种生活技能，各自独立却又相互影响，通过系统精灵给出的组合条件，乾劲可以很轻易的组合出无数种生活职业，冶炼加锻造，造就的自然是一位铁匠，但如果在铁匠的基础上，再加上魔法阵知识的话，这个普通的职业立刻就会摇身一变，成为一位锻造魔法装备的魔铸师！
而生活技能之间的组合，并非随随便便的加在一起，除了组合技能必须相辅相成之外，还附带着相当苛刻的条件。
进行组合的生活技能，必须达到宗师级别以上。
对于这一点限制，乾劲并不觉得奇怪，这跟现实没什么区别，只有在自己领域达到顶峰之后，才有资格将其他领域的特点融合进来，走出一条前人从未走过的道路，
近乎无限的可能，让乾劲有些心动。

content_en:
Chapter 1 Motivation! go ahead!
Since returning from the Sunset Mountains three days ago, Gan Jin has been shutting himself in his room, refusing to go out to see anyone no matter how much his roommate persuades him.
"It's so embarrassing...This is so embarrassing!"
Three days ago, Oakland College arranged an exam for the junior class in the Sunset Mountains.
Among the freshmen taking the exam, their motivation is definitely at the top level.
Less than a year after entering school, he already has the level of a third-level warrior. Even the instructor of the Oakland College Warrior Department, a fifth-level warrior Rodriguez, once said - Among the freshmen in the second class of junior warriors, the motivation is relatively promising. They are both talented and willing to endure hardship. Maybe in a few years, this kid will be able to surpass me, an old man...
Who would have thought that as soon as the instructor finished speaking, something happened to Ganjin on the Sunset Mountains.
Among the new students in the second class of junior warriors, there was a promising and energetic new student who was inexplicably knocked unconscious by something before he could even take the exam.
And what knocked him unconscious was actually a hat falling from the sky!
The incident was passed back as a joke and soon spread throughout Oakland College.
Now almost the entire Oakland College knows that there is a criminal-looking guy among the junior class freshmen. It is said that this guy's criminal-looking appearance has reached the point of anger and resentment. Even taking an exam can cause hats to fall from the sky and knock him unconscious on the spot.
Thinking that in the next few years, I will always be called a criminal-looking guy, I am so motivated that I even want to drop out of school.
"This life is really unbearable..."
What Gan Jin held in his hand was the culprit who knocked him unconscious that day.
This is a sky blue hat with a wide brim and a high and pointed crown. It is a standard mage hat. At Oakland College, almost every magic student wears such a hat.
It was precisely because of this that Gan Jin couldn't figure out how such an ordinary mage hat could hit him so hard that he fainted on the spot.
Just when I was puzzled, the door was pushed open again.
Entering the door was Rollin, one of Ganjin's best friends at Oakland College.
"Hahaha! It is said that a criminal-looking person has emerged from our college... Hey! Ganjin, why do you look so ugly?"
"Fuck!"
"Gengjin, your face looks so ugly. Could it be that you are sick? How about I help you get some medicine from Professor Ross? By the way, I heard that the exam that day was led by Professor Ross. I don't know if he knows that guy..."
"You know that guy too."
"Really?"
"I'm the criminal-looking guy!"
"..."
The more he thought about driving Luo Lin away, the more furious he became, so he simply covered his face with a hat and fell asleep.
…………
Ganjin stood outside the blacksmith shop and had been there for a long time.
"What the hell is this place..."
I have asked this question more than thirty times in the past two hours.
And the voice who called himself the system elf took the trouble to explain it to him more than thirty times.
"This is an endless world, a virtual game space built using third-generation virtual technology."
But Ganji still doesn’t understand what third-generation virtual technology is and what virtual game space is.
He did know virtuality, a word commonly used in illusion magic.
He also knew the game, just like the annual Auckland Cup.
But when these two words are put together, the motivation is a bit inexplicable, like a magic game? Depend on! This is all a mess...
So the system wizard had to continue to explain that the so-called virtual game is actually a world made up of numbers. This world seems extremely real, but in fact it is just a space made up of numbers.In order to explain it more clearly, the system wizard also gave a special number to explain what digital space is.
Occupation: Warrior
Level: 1
Strength: 18
Agility: 15
Stamina: 18
Intelligence: 15
Spirit: 1
HP: 180/180
Magic value: 110/110
Energy value: 180/180
Gan Jin knew that this number was true. Only those closest to him knew about his congenital mental disability. If it weren't for this reason, how could he, who came from a family of magicians and dual cultivators, come to this remote school and choose warrior as his profession?
Ganjin stood outside the blacksmith shop, feeling really dizzy.
Ever since taking the exam at Sunset Mountain, strange things happened to me one after another.
First, he was knocked unconscious by a hat falling from the sky. Not only did he fail the exam, but he also got a reputation for being a criminal. He wanted to hide in the dormitory and sleep, but accidentally fell asleep in another world, and it was also a virtual world made up of some numbers. What the hell...
If the voice that calls itself the System Elf had not said that the player would automatically return to the real world after eight hours of real time, I would be so motivated that I would even want to die.
The system elf said so much, and probably only these words can make Gan Jin feel a little more at ease.
Anyway, it’s only eight hours, so just treat it like a dream…
With this thought in mind, Gan Jing finally felt a little more at ease.
While Ganjin was thinking about how to spend this time, he looked at the blacksmith shop in front of him and asked, "Why do we come here?"
"Because before starting the game, you still need to choose life skills." The system wizard's voice is very nice, but I am really not in the mood to appreciate this beautiful voice.
"Life skills?"
"That's right."
Before he could think about it carefully, the system elf sent him information on life skills.
Looking at this information, Gan Jing somewhat understood what the so-called digital world meant.
From smelting to forging, from herbs to potions, there are dozens of life skills, each independent but affecting each other. Through the combination conditions given by the system wizard, Ganjin can easily combine countless life occupations. Smelting and forging will naturally create a blacksmith. But if you add the knowledge of magic circles to the blacksmith's foundation, this ordinary occupation will immediately transform into a magic forger who forges magic equipment!
The combination of life skills is not just added together casually. In addition to the combined skills having to complement each other, there are also quite stringent conditions attached.
The life skills to be combined must reach the master level or above.
Motivation is not surprised by this limitation. It is no different from reality. Only after reaching the peak of one's own field can one be qualified to integrate the characteristics of other fields and blaze a path that has never been taken before.
The nearly infinite possibilities make Gan Jin a little excited.
